def solve_qg3_v2(n=7):
    x = [[None]*n for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Set diagonal
    for i in range(n):
        x[i][i] = i
    
    def check_constraints():
        """Check all currently-set QG3 constraints"""
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                a = x[i][j]
                b = x[j][i]
                if a is not None and b is not None:
                    c = x[a][b]
                    if c is not None and c != i:
                        return False
        return True
    
    def get_candidates(i, j):
        """Get valid values for cell (i,j)"""
        used_row = set(v for v in x[i] if v is not None)
        used_col = set(x[r][j] for r in range(n) if x[r][j] is not None)
        return [v for v in range(n) if v not in used_row and v not in used_col]
    
    # Order cells: fill row by row, skip diagonal
    cells = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i != j:
                cells.append((i, j))
    
    def backtrack(idx):
        if idx == len(cells):
            return check_constraints()
        
        i, j = cells[idx]
        
        for v in get_candidates(i, j):
            x[i][j] = v
            
            if check_constraints():
                if backtrack(idx + 1):
                    return True
            
            x[i][j] = None
        
        return False
    
    if backtrack(0):
        return [[x[i][j] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    return None
